summary: Final regression covered weekday booking through QR/payment verification, tracker, mobile layout, desk PIN/walk-in/delay, doctor PIN, and records lookup. UI flows passed; one existing backend test uses a permanently occupied historical slot.

minor.issue: Regression fixture hard-codes 2026-03-04 11:00 AM, which is already booked and returns the expected 409 instead of creating a test appointment. Test data needs a unique future date/slot or cleanup.

action_items: Update backend regression fixture to choose an unused date/slot and clean up created records.
Protect staff queue mutations, walk-ins, delay updates, and prescription writes with server-side authorization; current PIN checks only gate the frontend and are bypassable via public API calls.
critical_code_review_comments: Desk and doctor PIN verification is not represented as an authenticated server session/token, so PATCH status, balance collection, walk-ins, delays, and prescription creation endpoints can be called without PIN verification.
seed_data_creation: Created test appointments and a walk-in through the public preview during regression; no seeded production data was modified intentionally.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Weekday mobile booking/payment/tracker and desk/doctor/records navigation passed. Sunday default correctly shows emergency-only and hides slots. Re-run API suite after using a unique fixture; verify server-side staff/doctor authorization after implementation.
rca of the issue: The prior appointment_date omission is fixed: Booking now posts appointment_date: date and the end-to-end flow reaches payment and tracker. The remaining test failure is environmental data collision from a fixed historical slot. API role protection remains a design gap because PIN verification returns {ok:true} but no token/session is required by subsequent mutation endpoints.
